icd.search_ph: Search by code or name (Arabic or English)
icd.raw_help: ICD-10 codes separated by commas — the first one is the primary diagnosis. The free-text diagnosis above stays as written.
icd.err_unknown: Unknown code: {codes}. Pick a code from the list or add it under Settings → Diagnosis codes.
icd.settings_lead: Doctors pick diagnoses from the WHO ICD-10 list while writing the consultation note. Add codes your clinic uses that are not on the list.
icd.active: Offer this code in the search
icd.code_help: Letters, digits, dots and dashes. Codes already in ICD-10 cannot be added again.
icd.delete_confirm: Delete the code {code}? Visits already coded with it keep their record.
icd.try_sub: {n} codes from WHO ICD-10, with Arabic and English titles and common names.
icd.needs_js: Searching needs JavaScript. On the visit page, codes can also be typed directly.
icd.source_note: Codes and English titles: WHO ICD-10 (2019). Arabic titles and search keywords: DocBook.
icd.custom_sub: Shown in the search next to the ICD-10 codes.
icd.custom_empty_text: Add a code for a diagnosis or procedure your clinic records often and that is not on the ICD-10 list.
icd.top_title: Most used in the last 12 months
icd.top_sub: These codes come first in the search.
icd.report_lead: The diagnoses recorded with ICD-10 codes in the period — how often, for how many patients and by which doctor.
icd.by_doctor_sub: Coded visits, patients and each doctor's most frequent codes.
icd.kpi_no_completed: No completed visits in this period
icd.kpi_patients_meta: With at least one coded diagnosis
icd.report_empty: No coded diagnoses in this period
icd.report_empty_text: Doctors add ICD-10 codes to the consultation note on the visit page.
icd.spec_sub: {n} ICD-10 diagnoses for your clinic's specialty, ready to use: they come first when a doctor searches a diagnosis. The table follows the clinic's specialty.

ctimer.label: Consultation time
ctimer.report_lead: Actual consultation minutes (from the timer on the visit page) against the booked slot, by doctor and service.
ctimer.by_service_sub: Minutes per service; the suggestion is the median rounded up to 5 minutes.
ctimer.insight: Consultations take {avg} min on average against {booked} min booked.
ctimer.insight_change: Consider {n}-minute slots so the day stays on time.
ctimer.report_empty: No timed consultations in this period
ctimer.report_empty_text: Doctors start and finish the timer on the visit page; completing the visit also stops it.
ctimer.excluded: {n} readings under 30 seconds or over 4 hours were left out.

privacy.lead: Decide who can open patients' clinical notes, and see who opened which record.
privacy.rule_sub: Applies to SOAP notes, diagnoses, prescriptions, vital-signs history, specialty records and patient documents.
privacy.opt_label: Only the treating doctor can open clinical notes
privacy.opt_help: Other staff see the patient's basic details only.
privacy.who_title: When this is on, the clinical record opens for:
privacy.who_treating: A doctor who has treated the patient or has a booking with them.
privacy.who_nurse: Nurses: the vital signs of the visit only.
privacy.who_emergency: Anyone with clinical editing rights who uses Emergency access (24 hours, reason required, the owner is notified).
privacy.who_others: Everyone else: basic patient details only.
privacy.safety_note: Allergies and chronic conditions stay visible to clinical staff for patient safety. Every opening of a record is written to the access log whether this is on or off.
privacy.bg_none: Nobody used emergency access in the last 30 days.
privacy.log_sub: Every opening of a patient file or a visit, last 30 days
privacy.log_lead: Who opened which patient's record, and when.
privacy.log_empty_text: Openings of patient files and visits appear here.
privacy.restricted_text: In this clinic only the treating doctor, the owner and managers can open this patient's clinical notes.
privacy.restricted_vitals: You can still record the vital signs of this visit.
privacy.timeline_restricted: Visits only — clinical notes are restricted
privacy.bg_hint: Need the record to treat this patient now?
privacy.bg_text: The record opens for you for {hours} hours. Your name, the time and the reason are logged and the clinic owner is notified.
privacy.bg_reason_ph: e.g. The patient came in with chest pain and their doctor is away.
privacy.bg_granted: Emergency access granted for {hours} hours. It has been logged.
privacy.bg_active_text: You opened this record with emergency access until {when}. Every view is logged.
privacy.notify_title: Emergency access: {name} opened the record of {patient}

errors_clinicalplus.RECORD_RESTRICTED: This patient's clinical notes are restricted to the treating doctor.
errors_clinicalplus.VISIT_CLOSED: This visit was cancelled or missed.
errors_clinicalplus.EMERGENCY_NOT_ALLOWED: You cannot request emergency access to this record.
errors_clinicalplus.ICD_CODE_EXISTS: This code is already on the ICD-10 list — use it from the search.
errors_clinicalplus.ICD_CODE_TAKEN: Your clinic already has this code.
